notify.title: Reminders & rewards
notify.blurb: A little encouragement, on your terms.
notify.deviceScope: One reminder schedule for all learners and courses on this device. At most one learning notification a day.
notify.on: Reminders are on for this device
notify.weeklyDetail: On Sunday at your chosen time, if you practised that week. Replaces that day’s practice reminder.
notify.saved: Saved. Your reminder choices are up to date.
notify.offerTitle: Make room for a little practice?
notify.offerBody: Choose a few days that suit you. We’ll skip the reminder when you’ve already practised.
notify.challengeBody: Practise on any three days this week. A finished lesson, test, conversation or daily XP goal earns a stamp.
notify.rest: You’ve made time to learn. Take a break whenever you like — your progress stays yours.
notify.smallStep: A short session is enough. Pick up where your learning path is ready.
notify.progressDetail: Based on saved activity across your courses. XP measures participation, not pronunciation accuracy.
notify.next: Next scheduled slot: {time}. Skipped if you’ve practised or are using the app.
notify.data: To deliver reminders, we store this browser’s push subscription, your schedule, course choices and recent practice dates on our server. No recordings or learner names are needed. Abandoned registrations are removed after 30 days.
notify.private: Lock-screen messages contain no learner names, scores or recordings. Notifications use your app language.
notify.autoPause: Reminders stop after seven days without opening the app. Opening it renews your schedule. Signing out turns off this device’s reminders.
notify.install: On iPhone or iPad, add Wunder Tutor to the Home Screen from Safari’s Share menu, then open it there to enable reminders.
notify.unsupported: This browser or app does not support web reminders. Your weekly progress and rewards still work here.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked. You can allow them in this website’s browser or system notification settings, then return here.
notify.auth: Sign in or enter your access code in Settings to connect reminders.
notify.unavailable: Web reminders are not connected yet. Your schedule can still be saved.
notify.network: Could not connect. Your previous reminder settings are unchanged; please try again.
notify.invalid: Choose at least one day and course, a valid timezone, and a reminder time outside quiet hours.
notify.otherDevice: Another device receives this account’s reminders. Enabling here moves them to this device.
notify.push.practice: A little practice, when you’re ready. Your next lesson is waiting.
notify.push.review: A quick review is ready. Revisit a little of what you’ve learned.
notify.push.weekly: Your weekly learning summary is ready. See the steps you’ve taken.
